angle: How a debut invitation should differ from a wedding one
caption:
Wedding invites keep things muted, but a debut card gets to feel like a party already.

· Craft cardstock in warm textured tones for debuts
· Modern layout choices instead of traditional script fonts
· Heavy paper weight that feels solid in hand
· Direct QR code printed on back for online RSVPs
